Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework

Class PlayerHandle

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.PlayerHandle
public final class PlayerHandle extends Object
Handle for a synthetic player.

This type exposes common player actions used in end-to-end tests and supports fluent method chaining for orchestration-style tests.

    • tabComplete

      public List<String> tabComplete(String commandLine)
      Computes command tab-completions for this player as if they had typed the given command-line buffer.

      The suggestions come from the live server command map and are permission-filtered for this player, so a bot that lacks a command's permission never sees it completed. A leading slash is accepted and normalized away agent-side, so "/gamemode" and "gamemode" behave identically; the buffer is otherwise passed through unmodified, so a trailing space (which selects argument completion rather than command-name completion) is preserved.

      Parameters:
      commandLine - The command-line buffer to complete; must not be blank.
      Returns:
      The tab-completion suggestions in server order; empty for an unknown command.

    • dropMainHandItem

      public DropResult dropMainHandItem()
      Simulates the player dropping their main hand item.

      An empty main hand (DropResult.EMPTY_HAND) is reported distinctly from a plugin cancelling the drop event (DropResult.CANCELLED); no event is fired at all for an empty hand. On a cancelled drop, the item entity is created and removed again to satisfy the Bukkit event contract, and the inventory is unchanged.

      Returns:
      The drop outcome.

    • clickChatComponent

      public PlayerHandle clickChatComponent(ChatComponentSnapshot component)
      Clicks the run_command action of a captured chat component by extracting its command and executing it as this player, exactly as a real player clicking the message would.

      Reuses the same execution path as executeCommand(String) (no new protocol command), so the extracted command is dispatched in this player's context with a leading slash normalized away.

      Parameters:
      component - The captured chat component to click; must carry a run_command click event.
      Returns:
      This handle for fluent chaining.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - When the component carries no run_command click event to execute.
